jurisdictions.name: Philadelphia
notes: Above-ground and in-ground pools and spas are listed among the projects that may qualify for an EZ permit, which is filed without plans.
The work must still follow the EZ Standard, and the city page says the permit can be revoked if it does not.
Applications can be filed online in eCLIPSE or in person at the Permit and License Center.

sources.title: Get permits without plans (EZ permits) (City of Philadelphia)

jurisdictions.name: Pittsburgh
jurisdictions.office: City of Pittsburgh Department of Permits, Licenses, and Inspections
notes: The residential pool form requires drawings by a PA licensed architect or engineer for all custom built pools and spas and any in-ground pool deeper than 4 feet.
A site plan must show the location and type of barriers in relation to the pool and property lines.
The form requires a barrier 48 inches above grade for the full perimeter, openings that do not pass a 4 inch sphere, and self-closing, self-latching gates.
The form states that all pools and spas need an electrical permit to ground and bond them.

sources.title: City of Pittsburgh Residential Pool Form

jurisdictions.name: Bethlehem (Lehigh Valley)
jurisdictions.office: City of Bethlehem Bureau of Code Enforcement
notes: For an in-ground pool, Bethlehem asks for a boundary and topographical survey, construction drawings, and the permit application.
The pool must be at least 6 feet from property lines and 10 feet from power lines.
An in-ground pool needs a fence at least 48 inches high, and the pool must have an alarmed door or self-locking gate.
The checklist asks for bonding of the walkway and an anti-suction drain device, and a licensed electrician must pull the electrical permit.

sources.title: Swimming Pool Requirements (City of Bethlehem Bureau of Code Enforcement)

jurisdictions.name: Newtown Township (Bucks County)
notes: The township lists swimming pools among the projects that need a permit and offers a separate In-ground Swimming Pool Application.
In-ground pool permits require the Professional Services Agreement supplement, which also applies to any permit needing stormwater management review of 1,000 sq ft or more of impervious surface.
Earth disturbance over 2,000 sq ft for a swimming pool requires plan review by the Bucks County Conservation District.
Plans larger than 11 x 17 must also be submitted as a PDF in addition to hard copies.

jurisdictions.name: Upper Moreland Township (Montgomery County)
notes: The township's FAQ says installing a pool requires a building permit and links to pool permit requirements.
The FAQ says residential applications need two sets of plans, and permits are required even when the homeowner does the work.
A registered Master Plumber must do all plumbing work, while owners may do their own electrical work with a permit.
